queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Microsoft .NET SDK 10.%' AND name LIKE '%(x64)' AND publisher = 'Microsoft Corporation';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Microsoft .NET SDK 10.%' AND name LIKE '%(x64)' AND publisher = 'Microsoft Corporation' AND version_compare(version, '10.4.326.52412') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'microsoft .net sdk 10.exe');
